title: Introduction to Algebraic Geometry

syllabus.details: Polynomial rings over fields, Hilbert basis theorem, Maximal ideals in polynomial rings over algebraically closed fields and Hilbert’s Nullstellensatz, affine algebraic sets, affine algebraic varieties, projective varieties.
Sheaves, locally ringed spaces, schemes,morphisms of schemes.

references: Qing Liu, Algebraic Geometry and Arithmetic curves, OUP Oxford, 2006, ISBN 0-19-850284-2,ISBN 978-0-19-850284-5
